title: Algo trading still tests your patience
author: plusaconstant
selftext:
One things I like most about algo trading is that the system follows its rules without fear or greed.

But a month goes by without a good trade, and the emotions are still there. And then you start doubting the strategy. Quiet month does not automatically mean a strategy is broken. It can recover when conditions suit it again, but that is never guaranteed.

The difficult part is knowing whether it is behaving within what you tested and expected, or whether something has actually changed. Automating the trades does not make that decision easy.
